unsupported: automatic promotion of model output to fact
capabilities.probe: Read AI-PORTAL.md, resolve capsule paths, report authority and working-tree state without mutation

write: project capsule declared write scope when authorized
network: explicitly connected services and approved browsing
runtime: mutation only on explicit task authority

state_transfer.dock: Load first-read documents, capsule state, current Git state, task intake, and relevant evidence
state_transfer.undock: Close pending writes, verify changes, update memory, and produce a handoff when work remains
state_transfer.handoff: Record goal, decisions, changed files, verification, unknowns, risks, and next action

failure.detect: Command, validation, policy, or state mismatch
failure.contain: Stop dependent mutations and preserve current diff and evidence
failure.rollback: Use file-local reversal or a named restore method only with explicit authority
failure.emergency_stop: Stop running sessions and report the unresolved state to the human

provenance.secret_policy: Do not copy secrets into prompts, capsule files, logs, or generated artifacts
